scope: Newly authored validation queries frozen before evaluation and not used for threshold/prompt tuning. Existing story targets overlap development labels; this is a query-level validation set, not an independent film-domain benchmark. Relevant IDs are illustrative, not exhaustive.
limitations: Relevant IDs are illustrative, not exhaustive; precision is not reported.
Raw vectors always return nearest neighbors and have no abstention threshold.
Baseline query embeddings may reuse the app cache; latency is not a fair system speed comparison.
Dataset scope is recorded above; illustrative human labels do not establish overall relevance or safety.
